## Checklist

- [ ] Sources are linked: every price, model or effort change links the provider page it was read from, with the date read.
- [ ] Fixtures are updated, and a reader change comes with a fixture that proves it (including a mutation fixture that must produce `needs-review`).
- [ ] The conformance vectors pass for every client this touches.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased, in the right section (Schema, Data or Repository).
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), and the subject is a plain imperative of at most 72 characters.
